note: Whitelisted frozen audit checkpoints; no wallet identities, private run files, raw intents, signatures or keys are included. Source audit digests identify the local evidence from which these summaries were produced. Pending is not a realized loss and later settlements can differ from these checkpoints.

limitations: Same incremental gross risk budget and fixed stake; starting wallet balances differ.
Mixed-cohort warmup is separate from fresh Classic games; native balance/ladder deltas can include older pending settlements.
Profit uses exact per-throw CLC returns and reports other assets separately; pending principal is not a realized loss.
Points attribution includes only matching throw-specific awards; game-wide awards are not invented or allocated speculatively.
MAE compares sequential current-known-board wallet-PnL forecasts with final wallet PnL; forecasts are correlated and unknown future throws can alter outcomes.
Selection-change evidence is a rescore of the complete already-valid candidate set, holding deterministic doctrine bias fixed; it is not a second independent physics run.
Four simultaneous players affect each other; this run is an exploratory comparison, not proof of a superior doctrine.
Per-agent candidate context was empty in 0 calls; those decisions could use the shared reference shortlist instead.
Settlement feedback can lag accepted throws. Resident result collection continues while paused; no forced settlement or second signing process is used.
